Funding & Support

Understand your purchase pathway.

Making the Right Product Easier to Access

WeMall helps individuals, families and care teams find suitable products and navigate the purchasing process with greater clarity. Whether a purchase is supported through care funding or paid privately, WeMall brings together product information, quotes, supporting documentation and practical assistance to make the journey easier.

Support at Home AT-HM

WeMall helps older people, families and care teams explore assistive technology, home modification and other products that may support independence, safety and everyday living under Support at Home.

Where funding or approval is required, product information, quotations and supporting documentation can assist the care team in considering the purchase against the participant’s individual needs, available funding and applicable program requirements.

NDIS Purchases

WeMall provides access to products that may support the everyday needs, independence and participation of NDIS participants.

Participants and their support networks can explore products, obtain quotations and supporting product information, and work with their relevant NDIS provider, plan manager or other representative to determine whether a proposed purchase is appropriate for their individual plan and circumstances.

Private Purchases

Not every purchase needs to involve funded care. WeMall also supports private purchases, giving individuals and families greater choice and flexibility to select products that meet their needs and preferences.

Customers can explore available products, compare options and purchase privately where appropriate.

Prescription Requirements

Some products may require professional assessment, prescription, recommendation or approval before they can be supplied or purchased through a funding program.

Where this applies, WeMall helps make relevant product information and supporting documentation available so customers can work with their care team or appropriately qualified health professional before proceeding.

Request a Quote

Need a formal quotation before making a decision or seeking approval?

WeMall makes it easier to request product quotations with the information needed to support consideration, approval and purchasing processes. Where applicable, quotations can include product details, pricing and other relevant information.

Request a Quote

Request Product Advice

Not sure which product is right for you?

WeMall can help connect customers with relevant product information and supplier support so they can better understand available options. Where clinical assessment or professional advice is required, customers should consult the appropriately qualified health professional involved in their care.

Request Product Advice

Delivery & Installation

WeMall connects purchasing with the practical steps that follow. Depending on the product and supplier, delivery, installation, setup or other related services may be available.

Relevant delivery and installation information should be confirmed before purchase so customers and care teams understand what is included and what additional arrangements may be required.

More choice. Clearer information. A simpler path from need to solution.
